items.text: Sun block: no Panvel–Vashi locals 11:05 am–4:05 pm; Thane–Kalyan 5th/6th lines 9 am–1 pm.
BMC's 10% water cut continues (20% for industry and commercial). Fix leaks, skip long showers.
Bombay HC: no bursting crackers on public roads, all year, all festivals. Use permitted private spaces.
Santacruz stuck near 38°C after the monsoon's early exit. Carry water, avoid long midday walks.
FDA suspended 29 food licences, incl. Sophia College canteen and Janata Bakery, Jogeshwari.
Aqua Line passport: collect stamps at 10 stations for ₹250. Limited stock, digital payment only.
